items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Ross Russell got us together to record with Charlie Parker and Wardell Gray and Dexter Gordon and Howard McGhee... So we did 'Pastels,' and after that we played another thing which we had made up called 'Trio.'

ctx.x: So the trio went on for a while. Then I came back to Los Angeles and I really got deeply into the recording scene, and that's how I guess I managed to record with so many people -- Wardell Gray, Dexter Gordon, Charlie Parker, Erroll Garner and Bumps Myers.

And then I was working for... I was an A&R man for a record company...I can't think of the company...but Jack Lauderdale was the President of the company, and he hired me as an A&R man. So Clark Terry, who was a friend, said, "Hey, I got a guy I want you to hear." So Lauderdale and I get into his Cadillac, and drive back to St. Louis to listen to Jimmy Forrest. So Jimmy Forrest played... I said, "Hey, let's record this guy." (I'll get to the rest in a second.) I said, "Hey, let's record it. This is wonderful." So…
